notes.title: INCOMING - Version 1.11 is now live!
notes.content:
[img]https://fbcdn-sphotos-b-a.akamaihd.net/hphotos-ak-xap1/t31.0-8/p526x395/10990264_645852332225502_2664574188425869316_o.jpg[/img]

INCOMING! Version 1.11 is live now on Steam addressing several issues Commanders were having with their war command consoles. 
- Replays will now reflect what has been reported!
- Improvements to Player Matching.
- Fixes for several dog-tag issues
-Commanders can now only show their loyalty to one alliance.
-Various bug fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: Patch Update 1.9.2
notes.content:
[img]https://scontent-b.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xap1/t31.0-8/10750142_578855802258489_9079975648420860419_o.jpg[/img]

INCOMING! Version 1.9.2 is live now on Steam. Fixing the following issues.
-Navel mines are now thoroughly thawed and will explode when ships come near them!
- Landmines will no longer just be for Heavy vehicles.
-Commanders will now receive detailed reports on their previous attacks.
- Level nine Command Bunkers will be able to view their enemies and be attacked!
